items.synEN: The teacher is invited by someone she likes to join a class reunion. They play a game to invite ghosts to make friends, unaware that curses are placed upon them. There is a reason for the malevolence.

items.title: Kuyank
items.synEN: Seven years before the Saranjana gate opened. In a village on water and swamps, in the interior of Kalimantan. The secret of the black magic "Kuyang" is about to be revealed.

items.title: Girls, We're Killing It!
items.synEN: In her desperate attempts at finding community during her college years, Adele decides to join The Girls--an exclusive sorority who are the source of dark and twisted rumors. But as the rituals begin, the lines between an elitist club and a cult blur and our heroine finds herself at a point of no return.

items.title: Pemikat Jiwa
items.synEN: Jay uses a forbidden love potion to make Wulan love him. However, the ritual instead binds Wulan's soul to a supernatural force that threatens her life, forcing Jay to face the horrific consequences of his actions.

items.title: Herança de Narcisa
items.synEN: Haunted by memories of her recently deceased mother, former star Narcisa, Ana decides to sell the childhood mansion she inherited and share the proceeds with her brother, Diego. However, the grim cleansing process reveals a legacy quite different from what she imagined.

items.title: Night of the Living Dead
items.synEN: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

items.title: 402 Rumah Sakit Angker Korea
items.synEN: A group of Indonesians: Juna, Adit, Bara, Arum, Yuri, and Tyas set out to live-stream a test of courage at the so-called most haunted hospital in South Korea, Yong-Won Hospital. Rumor has it that the hospital was once a front for a cult whose members chose to die following their leader. Now, the hospital is in a state of disrepair and no one dares to enter. This motivates Juna and his friends to become the first people to live-stream there.

items.title: Sin and Love
items.synEN: Police, drug lords, undercover agents, and spies—all layers of the power system are collapsing. Behind a seemingly lawful police hierarchy lies a city controlled by corruption, desire, and hidden power games, where human lives are only bargaining chips. A mysterious kidnapping exposes a buried network of crimes, unraveling misaligned identities, systemic corruption, and a long-suppressed past. Love and sex become tools of control and exchange. And the real chaos began ten years ago, within a forgotten relationship that never truly ended.

items.title: La Sposa!
items.synIT: Nella Chicago degli anni '30, un solitario Mostro di Frankenstein (Christian Bale) viaggia in cerca dell'aiuto della pionieristica scienziata Dr. Euphronious (Annette Bening), chiedendole di creare per lui una compagna. I due riportano in vita una giovane donna assassinata, e così nasce La Sposa (Jessie Buckley). Ma ciò che segue va ben oltre ogni aspettativa: omicidi! Possessioni! Un movimento culturale selvaggio e radicale! E due amanti fuorilegge uniti in una storia d’amore esplosiva e incontrollabile!
items.synEN: A lonely Frankenstein travels to 1930s Chicago to ask groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious to create a companion for him. The two revive a murdered young woman and The Bride is born. But what ensues is beyond what either of them imagined.

items.title: An Itch To Scratch
items.synEN: A man must resist the urge to scratch.

items.title: You Have Her Eyes
items.synEN: A woman's fears about having children begin to manifest as visions of her dead grandmother.

items.title: Get to Work
items.synEN: A man struggles in his bathroom through a severe panic attack as he desperately tries to work through it and get to work on time.

items.title: I Am The Bride
items.synEN: On The Death's Curve there's a legend: at 3:00 a.m. a bride dressed in white appears, waiting for her next victim. A detective teams up with a priest, a paranormal investigator, and a medium, to bring an end to this puzzle.

items.title: Black Box (Flight 298)
items.synEN: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.

items.title: PAN DE AJO
items.synEN: Victor, a shy and anxious guy, goes to Gabriel's apartment for the money he owes him. When he opens the door to Gabriel's room he will find nothing but horror...

items.title: Demon Hunter: Time 2 Kill
items.synEN: On the hunt to find the pieces of a medallion that can end the demonic control over Earth, Taryn is forced to go through time to save the future.

items.title: GOKDU;spreads its wings
items.synEN: Jang Min-gi has spent his life hiding a secret: he can see the dead. When his estranged father — the last in a line of Kokdu, ritual guardians who escort souls to the afterlife — dies under mysterious circumstances, Min-gi inherits both a worn puppet kit and a burden he never wanted. Drawn into a thirty-year-old betrayal surrounding a burned funeral bier, he must confront an imprisoned soul demanding vengeance.

items.title: Delivery Man
items.synEN: Guy, a reclusive food delivery rider, develops feelings for Sai, a woman he delivers to regularly. His obsession soon borders on stalking — even though Sai is already married to Dith.

items.title: The Fetus
items.synEN: A couple struggle to learn the truth about the origins of their unborn child-- a demonic entity that emerges from the body.

items.title: Kraken
items.synIT: La biologa marina Johanne sta facendo ricerche in un allevamento ittico a Vangsnes, una comunità rurale situata vicino al fiordo, quando incontra diversi strani eventi. Insieme alla morte brutale di due adolescenti locali, tutti i segni indicano il fiordo profondo; può esserci di più in profondità di quanto l'occhio possa vedere? In fondo al fiordo più profondo riposa un mostro mitico grande come una montagna, con una miriade di braccia pronte a schiacciare e divorare qualsiasi cosa riescano ad afferrare.
items.synEN: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

items.title: Home A Loan
items.synEN: A tenacious mother Eun-jin forces her family to move into a rundown apartment, hoping for a luxurious rebuild. However, she loses her sanity as her plan fails and becomes harmful to those who she vowed to protect.

items.title: Night Comes
items.synEN: Against the backdrop of a cataclysmic event that threatens to engulf humanity, two sisters manage to escape the horror only to find themselves thrust into a perilous struggle for survival, tasked with a mission that holds the fate of mankind in the balance.

items.title: CURSED MEME
items.synEN: Yura, a young girl who struggles to fit in with her classmates, discovers an old smartphone while helping clean out a disused school building. Out of curiosity, she and her friends power it on. Soon afterward, strange videos featuring the children themselves begin appearing on their phones. At first, the clips seem like harmless jokes and are consumed much like viral internet memes. What the children do not realize, however, is that these videos are foretelling a horrifying future that awaits them.

items.title: Cuidado, Garoto
items.synEN: A young man is drawn to a handsome guy, but his insecurities stand in his way.

items.title: HotSpring SharkAttack 2: Great Kyushu Showdown
items.synEN: A massive swarm of clone sharks rises from hot springs and volcanoes, leading to a jaw-dropping showdown that throws all of Kyushu into total chaos! The story follows a high school girl and her bond with an Onsen Shark.

items.title: Nyepi
items.synEN: Tae-pyeong, Yoon-chae and their friends embark on a journey to Bali, captivated by its mystical landscapes. Their local guide, Nova, explains the significance of the upcoming Nyepi Day — Bali's sacred Day of Silence, when all forms of eating, pleasure, travel and even lights must cease. While exploring the island, Tae-pyeong accidentally breaks a mysterious urn, triggering a series of strange and terrifying events that soon force them to violate the sacred rules of Nyepi Day against their will. As reality warps around them, Tae-pyeong begins to realize that a far more sinister force is at play — one that may not let them leave the island alive.

items.title: Talion
items.synEN: On their way to a remote vacation spot, a young couple witnesses a fatal hunting accident. Far from civilization and cut off from any help, they start to question the hunters' intentions.

items.title: Siren
items.synEN: One day, Seol-i’s father, Captain Park, captures a mermaid.

items.title: Septicemia
items.synEN: When a young girl pleading for help knocks on Florence’s door, Florence discovers the girl is hiding more than what she is willing to share…

items.title: Eve
items.synEN: While visiting her father's apartment, a woman discovers that the man who raised her might be something less than human.

items.title: Killing Time
items.synEN: In an era of economic despair and record-high unemployment, where becoming a YouTuber is the ultimate dream job, the popular YouTube crew 'Killing Time' collapses overnight after an unforeseen accident claims a team member's life during a live broadcast. Desperate for a successful comeback, the members plot to return with far more extreme and sensational content. However, just as success seems within reach, mysterious figures appear and propose the 'real' Killing Time.

items.title: The Waiting Man
items.synEN: In 2022, the famous streaming group TOMNI was at the height of its popularity with over 7 million followers. Over the course of a week, their content changed and then they suddenly vanished. This is the footage recovered from their social media, computers, and SD cards. Experts believe the footage shows the worldwide phenomenon known as Alikabiha, also called the Waiting Man.

items.title: Silo
items.synIT: In un futuro tossico e in rovina, migliaia di persone vivono in un enorme silo sotterraneo. Dopo la violazione di una regola cardine da parte dello sceriffo e la morte misteriosa di alcuni residenti, Juliette, un tecnico, comincia a svelare dei segreti scioccanti e la verità sul silo.
items.synEN: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

items.title: Perempuan Pembawa Sial
items.synEN: Mirah, a woman shunned by her village after the mysterious deaths of men connected to her, seeks refuge in a Padang restaurant owned by Bana, who falls in love with her. As more men die, Mirah discovers she’s cursed by her stepsister Puti with the deadly “Bahu Laweyan” curse, which kills any man who becomes intimately involved with her. Fueled by revenge, Mirah plans to destroy Puti’s happiness by targeting her husband. Despite the deadly curse, Mirah and Bana craft their own tragic love story, choosing to be together no matter the consequences.

items.title: Touch Me
items.synEN: Two codependent best friends become addicted to the heroin-like touch of an alien narcissist who may or may not be trying to take over the world.

items.title: Anaconda
items.synIT: Doug e Griff sono migliori amici fin dall’infanzia e hanno sempre sognato di rifare il loro film preferito di tutti i tempi: il “classico” cinematografico Anaconda. Quando una crisi di mezza età li spinge a buttarsi finalmente nell’impresa, partono per le profondità dell’Amazzonia per iniziare le riprese. Ma le cose si fanno serie quando appare improvvisamente una vera anaconda gigante, trasformando il loro set caotico e comico in in una trappola mortale. Il film che muoiono dalla voglia di girare? Potrebbe letteralmente ucciderli...
items.synEN: A group of friends facing mid-life crises head to the rainforest with the intention of remaking their favorite movie from their youth, only to find themselves in a fight for their lives against natural disasters, giant snakes and violent criminals.

items.title: Lee Cronin - La Mummia
items.synIT: La giovane figlia di un giornalista scompare nel deserto senza lasciare traccia. Otto anni dopo, la famiglia, ancora devastata dal dolore, viene sconvolta dal suo improvviso ritorno: quello che dovrebbe essere un ricongiungimento gioioso si trasforma rapidamente in un incubo a occhi aperti.
items.synEN: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace—eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them, as what should be a joyful reunion turns into a living nightmare.

items.title: Frankie Freako
items.synEN: After calling a late-night party hotline that promises out-of-this-world fun, uptight yuppie Conor Sweeney must battle the pint-sized forces of evil unleashed through his phone line, led by the maniacal rock n’ roll goblin FRANKIE FREAKO.

items.title: Ghost Board
items.director: ชนาธิป วงศ์พลตรี
items.synEN: A group of friends stumbles upon an ancient board game hidden in a remote temple. Once the die is cast, a vengeful spirit is unleashed, turning the game into a deadly trap. To survive, they must figure out how to end it before they become its next victims.

items.title: The Strangers: Chapter 3
items.synEN: Tethered by a frightening conclusion, Maya and the Strangers are locked on an unavoidable, unforgiving collision course — a showdown that proves they’re far from strangers now.

items.title: The Mortuary Assistant
items.synEN: Rebecca Owens, a recent mortuary science graduate takes a night shift job at River Fields Mortuary. Initially, the job seems straightforward — embalming bodies, completing paperwork, and keeping things tidy. But once Rebecca starts working the night shift, things take a dark turn.

items.title: Blankets
items.synEN: A mother attempts to resurrect her dead husband with the help of her eleven year old son.

items.title: Sardiñas
items.synEN: A mother doesn't understand the life that her daughter wants to live. A daughter wants to be free but finds herself trapped by family, religion and gender. The mother tries to enter her daughter's world, she doesn't know how to live with it. Should we try and break this eternal generational gap, or keep still, trapped inside a little can of sardines. Symbols and suffocation chase us.

items.title: Tropical SOV: Bizarro Sci-fi Samba
items.synEN: Once again, 23 Brazilian filmmakers come together for the second Tropical SOV anthology, now exploring sci-fi in humorous stories involving aliens and their space invasions, mad scientists, time travel, dystopias, and a myriad of end-of-the-world scenarios.

items.title: Focus
items.synEN: Eun-ho, a photographer, acquires a used camera, only to discover a ghost appearing in his photos and reality. As the camera behaves erratically, he experiences terrifying hallucinations, ruining his relationship and jeopardizing his career. Seeking help, he turns to Gwang-myeong, a forensic hypnosis expert, to uncover the camera’s secrets and perform an exorcism.

items.title: The Mage
items.synEN: A series of deaths suddenly occurs in the city. Police officer Wong Ming realizes that at the scene of each death, there is the figure of a woman who collects garbage. In the course of investigation, Wong discovers that this woman, Lan Pui Ching (played by Josie HO), has the mysterious ability to collect the souls of the accidental deaths from the garbage and help these souls to enter the reincarnation. This all started with a story that happened to her 13 years ago. Meanwhile, the murders continue to happen. Lan Pui Ching deduces that these murders are related to a mysterious cult ritual, and she and Wong Ming will be the next victims of this ritual. Wong Ming decides to cooperate with Lan Pui Ching to find out the mastermind behind the scene.

items.title: The Mouths
items.synEN: Feature-length adaptation of Sesuji's "Kuchi ni Kansuru Ankēto".

items.title: Lockbox
items.synEN: A woman puts her life on the line to protect her troubled, enigmatic cousin, Winthrop, who has been targeted and hunted by a powerful supernatural force.

items.title: Human Vapor
items.synEN: When a guest commentator swells and explodes on live TV in an unprecedented and unimaginable crime, the whole world is thrown into shock. Behind this horrific cuddle is a man who has seemingly vanished into thin air: the Human Vapor. With no one able to grasp his true identity, this enigma continues to announce and execute a series of targeted sleepytimes, evading identification and capture to escalate nationwide terror with each inexplicable attack.

items.title: Pee Nak 5
items.synEN: A year after the deadly battle that finally subdued the vengeful ghost of Nak Tinn, the cycle of vengeance returns once again.

items.title: Tenement
items.synEN: Following her mother’s death, manga artist Soriya travels to her ancestral home in Phnom Penh, with hopes of reconnecting with her distant family and using the visit as inspiration for her work. All goes well initially. Renting an apartment in Metta, a rundown Khmer Rouge-era housing complex, her visit to her maternal relatives finds her welcomed with open arms. But Soriya’s waking hours in the apartment and its surroundings are punctuated by terrifying, bloody visions, almost as though she were a conduit for horrors of the past wanting to seep into the present.

items.title: Bajo tus pies
items.synEN: Isabel moves with her two children into a very prestigious building that has a very peculiar admission method but at a very affordable rental fee. Once approved and settled, three elderly neighbors from the lower floor will turn their lives upside down.

items.title: Tumbal Proyek
items.synEN: In the midst of a major bridge project connecting two regions, life after life is lost during its construction. Yuda, along with his sister and mother, infiltrates the construction company where their father was killed to prove that the project's sacrificer are real.

items.title: Finché morte non ci separi 2
items.synIT: Poco dopo essere sopravvissuta ad un attacco senza esclusione di colpi da parte della famiglia Le Domas, Grace (Samara Weaving) scopre di aver raggiunto il livello successivo di questo gioco da incubo, questa volta con al suo fianco la sorella Faith (Kathryn Newton) con cui non aveva più rapporti. Grace ha una sola possibilità per sopravvivere, per salvare la vita della sorella e rivendicare il Posto D’Onore del Consiglio che controlla il mondo. Quattro famiglie rivali le stanno dando la caccia per il trono, e chi vincerà governerà su tutto.
items.synEN: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.

items.title: Anna, Postmortem
items.synEN: When a young woman is murdered for mysterious reasons, her ghost searches for answers - and revenge.

items.title: Mirage
items.synEN: A young man searches the city at night for a woman and is led by her into an initiation ritual.

items.title: Petaka Gunung Welirang
items.synEN: Five friends camp on Mount Welirang. On their way to the summit, they encounter a Queen and her royal troops. What mysteries lie hidden within Mount Welirang?

items.title: Worst Neighbor Ever
items.synEN: You think you know your neighbors? Think again. This new series features firsthand accounts of violence, intimidation, and harassment that are more shocking than ever. Through compelling testimonials, startling body cam footage, and animated reenactments, Worst Neighbor Ever proves the people next door aren't just a nuisance - they're lethal.

items.title: Tinsman Road
items.synEN: In the backwoods of New Jersey a young man navigates the serpentine mystery surrounding his long-missing sister and their family home.

items.title: Barbarian
items.synIT: Arrivata a Detroit per un colloquio, una giovane donna prenota una casa in affitto. Ma arriva tardi la sera e scopre che la casa è stata prenotata due volte e uno strano uomo è già lì. Contro ogni buonsenso, decide di passare lì la sera, ma presto scopre che c'è molto più da temere che un ospite inaspettato della casa.
items.synEN: In town for a job interview, a young woman arrives at her Airbnb late at night only to find that it has been mistakenly double-booked and a strange man is already staying there. Against her better judgement, she decides to stay the night anyway.

items.title: Kwaidan - Storie di fantasmi
items.synIT: Quattro storie di fantasmi ispirate a leggende popolari nipponiche. Episodio 'The black hair': un samurai torna a casa dopo molti anni e scopre che la moglie è un fantasma. Episodio 'The woman of the snow': un viandante viene salvato da un tempesta di neve da una misteriosa donna. Episodio 'Hoichi, the earless': un musicista cieco si esibisce davanti ad una corte di spettri protetto da un mantra sacro tatuato sul corpo. Episodio 'In a cup of tea': uno scrittore ha difficoltà nel concludere una storia di un uomo che vede un misterioso volto riflesso nel tè.
items.synEN: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden, but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup.

items.title: Leviticus
items.synEN: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most — each other.

items.title: Obsession
items.synIT: Dopo aver spezzato il misterioso bastoncino del desiderio per conquistare il cuore della ragazza che ama un romantico senza speranza ottiene esattamente ciò che ha chiesto ma presto scopre che alcuni desideri hanno un prezzo sinistro e pericoloso.
items.synEN: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

items.title: Living Corpse
items.synEN: Yosuke Shinkai is haunted by a past he cannot recall - and a body that is rapidly decomposing. He is a living corpse, unclear who he is or why he has been brought back to life only to suffer again a slow gruesome death. Based on the 1986 horror manga by Hideshi Hino.

items.title: Blood and Filth
items.synEN: A wild Israeli horror-comedy, with neither boundaries nor responsibility, combining  a dysfunctional family, demons, murders, a dark legend and a lot of chaos.

items.title: The Second Child
items.synEN: Weaves a mysterious narrative between a mother who encounters her deceased daughter's doppelganger, and her second daughter who awakens from a coma.

items.title: No Volveré
items.synEN: A lonely ventriloquist is served divorce papers at the showroom bar where he works. Things take a strange turn when he tries to remedy the situation with his puppet, Luis.

items.title: Amityville Shark House
items.synEN: In a house in Amityville, strange things are about to happen when a shark is involved.

items.title: Chasing Shadows
items.synEN: Heather invites her new friends over for a sleepover of secrets and face masks. But soon, her mistreatment of those around her comes back with a haunting grin, and nowhere to run.

items.title: Exit 8
items.synIT: Un uomo intrappolato in un infinito corridoio sterile della metropolitana si mette alla ricerca dell'uscita 8. Le regole della sua ricerca sono semplici: non trascurare nulla che sia fuori dall'ordinario. Se scopri un'anomalia, torna immediatamente indietro. Se non la trovi, prosegui. Poi esci dall'uscita 8. Ma anche una sola svista lo riporterà al punto di partenza. Riuscirà mai a raggiungere il suo obiettivo e a fuggire da questo corridoio infinito?
items.synEN: A man trapped in an endless sterile subway passageway sets out to find Exit 8. The rules of his quest are simple: do not overlook anything out of the ordinary. If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?

items.title: Restless
items.synEN: After losing his parents in an accident, Jason Gaterson slowly begins going crazy

items.title: The Shadowman's Nightmare
items.synEN: In 1995, Ken Holden, the actor known for portraying The Shadowman in the Australian children's television show Hug The Sun, self-funded his own expansion tape to the Australian video board game NIGHTMARE.  After Ken's mysterious disappearance over 30 years ago, this tape was thought to be lost to time... Until today.

items.title: You're Just Tired
items.synEN: Feeling isolated, lonely, and bored, new mother Lydia struggles to grasp what's real and what's her imagination.

items.title: Night of the Vamp-Friars
items.synEN: A group of friends in a punk rock band discover a hidden cemetery in the woods where they accidentally raise a group of undead Friars.

items.title: Noppera
items.synEN: Inspired by the Japanese yokai Noppera-bo, this psychological horror short follows Avery, an ambitious photographer who stumbles upon an abandoned cabin deep within the woods. As reality begins to unravel around him, Avery is forced to confront the guilt, trauma, and consequences of his past actions revealing a dark hisotry.

items.title: undertone
items.synEN: The host of a popular paranormal podcast becomes haunted by terrifying recordings mysteriously sent her way.

items.title: Forbidden Fruits
items.synEN: Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of the mall store after hours - with fellow fruits Cherry and Fig. But when new hire Pumpkin challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.

items.title: Midnight Knocks at the Door
items.synEN: Stripped of color and clothes, ready to be cleansed. A young man's midnight bath becomes a surreal nightmare the moment he realizes he is not alone.

items.title: CAMP
items.synEN: Emily is the cause of two tragedies early in her life; her dad suggests she go to a Camp for troubled youth to ease her guilt. When Emily arrives, she is taken in by the other counsellors; they accept her as she is and wrap her in a veil of peace & forgiveness. Emily stands at the forefront of a new kind of life, but there’s a voice out there in the woods she can’t ignore, telling Emily to go home.

items.title: Oh My Ghost! Oh My God!
items.synEN: Japanese diva Juliet unexpectedly finds a photo of her parents taken by a certain spiritual lake after her mother’s passing. To fulfill her mother’s wish, she embarks on a journey to reminisce about her mother’s roots in Taiwan. Juliet enlists her old friend to help her team up the mountain and they encounter supernatural phenomena and become trapped in thick fog. However, the true horror awaits as Juliet’s hidden secrets unwittingly attract evil spirits…

items.title: Strung
items.synEN: A talented violinist whose prestigious new role as a music tutor for an enigmatic, elite family spirals into a psychological battle for her safety and sanity.

items.title: Valencia
items.synEN: One December night, Alice works as a babysitter while the baby's parents go out for the night. As time passes and the night deepens, she begins to receive chilling threats from a man who seems to be watching her from every blind spot in the darkness.

items.title: Cold Storage
items.synIT: La storia ruota attorno a una minaccia globale causata da un fungo extraterrestre altamente infettivo e mutante, capace di trasformare gli esseri umani in creature letali. Decenni prima degli eventi principali, un microrganismo letale viene recuperato e confinato in una struttura militare sotterranea segreta dal governo degli Stati Uniti. A causa di un guasto tecnico nel sistema di raffreddamento della struttura di stoccaggio, la temperatura sale, permettendo al fungo di risvegliarsi e iniziare a diffondersi. Un ex agente governativo ormai in pensione (Liam Neeson), che conosceva i pericoli del virus, dovrà collaborare con due dipendenti di un deposito (interpretati da Joe Keery e Georgina Campbell) per contenere l'epidemia prima che il fungo raggiunga la superficie con effetti potenzialmente devastanti per l'intera umanità.
items.synEN: When a mutating, highly contagious fungus escapes a sealed facility, two employees – joined by a grizzled bioterror operative – must survive the wildest night shift ever to save humanity from extinction.

items.title: Judge Michael - Rise of the Law
items.synEN: A new enemy has risen on mega city one, his name is Voss Kane " The Ripper " bringing chaos to the streets, now a new judge has emerged from the hall of justice teached by Dredd himself, to uphold the law and bring justice to the streets.

items.title: Black Box (Flight 298)
items.synEN: The supernatural events surrounding Vero Airlines Flight 298 from New Orleans to Seattle.

items.title: The Djinn's Curse 2
items.director: เกรียงไกร มณวิจิตร
items.synEN: In a village at the foot of Mount Budo, Diana begins behaving violently after disappearing into the forest, forcing her husband Anas to kill her.

items.title: Ghost in the Cell
items.synEN: A notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

items.title: Scream 7
items.synIT: Quando un nuovo assassino mascherato da Ghostface semina il terrore nella tranquilla cittadina dove Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) ha ricostruito la sua vita, i suoi incubi più profondi diventano realtà: la prossima vittima designata è sua figlia (Isabel May). Decisa a proteggere ciò che ama, Sidney dovrà riaprire le porte del suo passato e affrontare, una volta per tutte, l’orrore che pensava di aver lasciato alle spalle.
items.synEN: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, Sidney must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.

items.title: The Producer
items.synEN: Tom, a young ambitious producer starts spiralling three years into his career when he begins hearing voices and seeing himself in ways that frighten him.

items.title: Return to Your Dreams
items.synEN: Waking up from a dream he can’t seem to forget, Faizan struggles to maintain the newly structured life he’s built for himself, dazed and lost in thought. And as more memories from his past continue to resurface, he soon learns that the nightmarish ones still refuse to let him go.

items.title: Feed
items.synEN: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

items.title: The Killings: Parrish Station
items.synEN: It's 1987, and Detective Georgia Cooke is called in to investigate the massacre of four scientists who have been brutally murdered in inexplicable ways, with a lone survivor the obvious suspect. But as Georgia digs deeper, unravelling a complex case entangled in mania, ritual, and the occult, her obsessive quest for the truth spirals into a nightmare that will put her family, career, and sanity on the line. 37 years later, a chilling new spree of murders will pull Georgia back into this nightmare as she confronts the terrifying possibility that the horrors at Parrish Station were never fully buried.

items.title: Finché morte non ci separi 2
items.synIT: Poco dopo essere sopravvissuta ad un attacco senza esclusione di colpi da parte della famiglia Le Domas, Grace (Samara Weaving) scopre di aver raggiunto il livello successivo di questo gioco da incubo, questa volta con al suo fianco la sorella Faith (Kathryn Newton) con cui non aveva più rapporti. Grace ha una sola possibilità per sopravvivere, per salvare la vita della sorella e rivendicare il Posto D’Onore del Consiglio che controlla il mondo. Quattro famiglie rivali le stanno dando la caccia per il trono, e chi vincerà governerà su tutto.
items.synEN: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.

items.title: The Lovers
items.synEN: Sara Lim Baylon , a reluctant seafood chef from Binondo, Manila. As the youngest member of her family to run their restaurant, Sara faces the daunting pressure to live up to her late father's reputation and keep the business afloat. When the governor's inauguration dinner is planned at the restaurant, featuring a sirena as the centerpiece, Sara finds herself drawn into a dangerous affair with the mythical creature.

items.title: INNER
items.synEN: A writer becomes trapped in a shifting reality where space mirrors his inner world, forcing him to confront a version of himself he no longer recognizes.

items.title: Crash Season
items.synEN: When a scar on Mari's chin mysteriously disappears, Max begins to believe her girlfriend has been replaced by an imposter.

items.title: Our House
items.synEN: A young couple are stalked by a presence in the middle of the countryside

items.title: The Styx
items.synEN: In search of absolution, a grieving man descends into a nightmarish inferno of guilt, fear, and judgment

items.title: The Agency: Central Intelligence
items.synIT: A Martian, agente segreto della CIA, viene ordinato di rientrare alla Stazione di Londra. Quando la donna che ha lasciato riappare inaspettatamente, il loro amore si riaccende, gettandoli in un gioco mortale di intrighi internazionali e spionaggio.
items.synEN: The Agency: Central Intelligence follows Martian, a covert CIA agent ordered to abandon his undercover life and return to London Station. When the love he left behind reappears, romance reignites. His career, his real identity and his mission are pitted against his heart; hurling them both into a deadly game of international intrigue and espionage.

items.title: Little Nightmares - Broken Promises
items.synEN: Locked in an attic, a neglected little girl escapes into a miniature world full of promise, until she discovers its terrible secrets: behind every shadow lurks a monster.

items.title: Short Sharp Scares: Teraphobia
items.synEN: Fear isn't always irrational.

items.title: Static Windows
items.synEN: At 3:13 AM, a lonely insurance worker notices a pale figure standing outside his window, quietly filming him in the dark. Night after night he searches for answers, but the closer he gets to the truth, the less it seems to make sense. Soon the line between watcher and watched begins to dissolve.

items.title: Ágatha Não Matou Seu Psiquiatra
items.synEN: In a therapy session, secrets emerge, turning the encounter between Ágatha and her psychiatrist into a dangerous psychological game.

items.title: Oasis
items.synEN: Oasis is the most luxurious holiday resort in the country — a paradise reserved for the wealthiest families, featuring private beaches, VIP facilities, and impenetrable security. The perfect place to spend the best summer of your life. But everything falls apart when the police storm the resort to investigate a mysterious disappearance. In such an exclusive place, everyone is a suspect — and no one can leave until the culprit is found.

items.title: Our Effed Up World
items.synEN: Sheri thought her biggest problem in life was dealing with the recent loss of her beloved grandma.  But when a mysterious entity crash lands in the woods, only she and her group of shitkicker friends are what stands in the way of an insatiable, intergalactic hunger.

items.title: The Voices of Our Mother
items.synEN: When a family matriarch falls seriously ill, relatives gather and discover their shared ancestral ties bind them in unexpected ways.

items.title: Sugar
items.synIT: Un enigmatico investigatore privato lotta contro i propri demoni mentre indaga sulla scomparsa dell’amata nipote di un produttore di Hollywood.
items.synEN: John Sugar is an American private investigator on the heels of the mysterious disappearance of Olivia Siegel, the beloved granddaughter of legendary Hollywood producer Jonathan Siegel. As Sugar tries to determine what happened to Olivia, he will also unearth Siegel family secrets; some very recent, others long-buried.

items.title: Symbiosis
items.synEN: A weekend reunion at an isolated house turns sinister when old friends realise their host, and the house itself, may want more than their company.

items.title: Passenger
items.synIT: Dopo aver assistito a un raccapricciante incidente sull’autostrada, una giovane coppia riparte convinta di essersi lasciata tutto alle spalle. Ma qualcosa è salito a bordo con loro. Una presenza demoniaca, si annida nell’ombra, silenziosa e inesorabile. Non si fermerà finché non li avrà presi entrambi, trasformando il loro viaggio on the road in una discesa senza ritorno nell’incubo.
items.synEN: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger that won't stop until it claims them both turns their van life adventure into a nightmare.

items.title: Kill your Darlings
items.synEN: Alan is presented with a unique opportunity by a mysterious woman. But what seems to be a satisfaction of his darkest desires escalates in a way he couldn’t have seen coming…

items.title: Tahle párty je DEAD
items.synEN: When responsible Alice, superficial Sofie, crazy Hanka, and insecure Roman head out to a Halloween party, they have no idea that a night of madness and chaos is about to begin. A chain of arguments, embarrassing moments, and bad decisions quickly spirals out of control, leading to absurd and wild situations involving zombies, police officers, and frustrated romantic comedy actors. On her mission to rescue her younger sister Kristýna, Alice discovers that the real danger lies not so much in the zombies as in mutual prejudices and poor role models.

items.title: Harlan Coben's I Will Find You
items.synIT: Un padre innocente, condannato all'ergastolo per l'omicidio di suo figlio, riceve prove che il suo bambino potrebbe essere ancora vivo. Dovrà evadere di prigione per scoprire la verità.
items.synEN: Harlan Coben's I Will Find You follows an innocent father serving life in prison for murdering his own son, who receives evidence that his child may actually still be alive — and must break out of prison to find the truth.

items.title: Hippo's Revenge
items.synEN: A father and daughter prepare to open their Safari Rescue in England, featuring a mother hippo and her calf. But when a ruthless criminal plots to steal them under the cover of night, chaos erupts.

items.title: Dolly
items.synEN: Young Macy is abducted by a deranged, monstrous figure who wants to raise her as its child.

items.title: Bodycam
items.synEN: A call to a quiet suburban home unleashes unthinkable carnage when two officers mistakenly shoot a man and his infant child, spiraling the tragedy into a fierce, unrelenting fall into the unknown.

items.title: Hoppy Ending
items.synEN: A cheerful Easter village, famous for its giant bunny mascots and pastel-colored egg hunts, hides a dark secret. Years ago, a corporate Easter mascot company mysteriously went bankrupt, and the mascots “disappeared” during the closing ceremony. Locals whisper about the “Hollow Hare,” a terrifying entity born from the mascots’ abandoned costumes and the children’s forgotten toys.

items.title: Cerita Lila
items.synEN: Based on the investigation story of Sara Wijayanto.

items.title: Dukun Magang
items.synEN: Raka is a final-year student frustrated by the constant rejection of his thesis by his lecturers. Sekar, his college friend, suggests that his thesis explore the world of shamanism. Meanwhile, Mbah Djambrong is a legendary and eccentric shaman from Kalimati, a remote village renowned for its supernatural traditions, holding mysteries about humanity's relationship with the mystical and spiritual world.

items.title: Dust Bunny
items.synIT: Aurora, una bambina di dieci anni, chiede al suo vicino sicario di uccidere il mostro sotto il suo letto che, secondo lei, ha divorato la sua famiglia. Per proteggerla, il vicino deve affrontare un'ondata di assassini, accettando al contempo che alcuni mostri siano reali.
items.synEN: Ten-year-old Aurora asks her hitman neighbor to kill the monster under her bed that she claims ate her family. To protect her, he must battle an onslaught of assassins while accepting that some monsters are real.

items.title: My Strange Arrest
items.synEN: An in-depth look at the people who were arrested for allegedly committing some of the weirdest, wildest and most bizarre crimes ever. We dig beyond the headlines and the viral videos to look at the incidents and their consequences, hearing the stories from the accused, the arresting officers and eyewitnesses. These are bizarre crimes with real-life ramifications.

items.title: Backrooms
items.synIT: Se non fai attenzione e superi la barriera della realtà, entrerai nelle backrooms. Se finisci lì dentro, resta vigile, perché i passi che echeggiano in quelle stanze potrebbero non essere solo i tuoi…
items.synEN: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

items.title: The Grieving
items.synEN: Mia, a mourning daughter, attempts to lay her father to rest, only to uncover the dangerous demons he was battling. As she struggles to make sense of a world without him, grief gives way to a chilling truth.

items.title: Southern Scares
items.synEN: Mystery, horror, and Southern folklore collide in the 1990s when a video store worker discovers chilling secrets found in her missing sister's documentary series, Southern Scares.

items.title: The Invisible Half
items.synEN: Elena, a "half" Japanese high school girl, struggles with her identity. While constantly watched, she discovers she's also being watched by something else—a monster that can only be seen through her smartphone and heard through her earphones.

items.title: Remember Death
items.synEN: After a terminal diagnosis, Charlie realises that her time is near, leaving her with only a few weeks left to live. But she soon realises that death isn't unseen like she thinks.

items.title: The Wicker Children
items.synEN: Undercover cop investigates disappearance of mother tied to cult, unraveling dark pagan rituals involving her strange children at secluded country house.

items.title: Grantchester
items.synIT: Nel villaggio di Grantchester, vicino Cambridge, il vicario locale, Sidney Chambers, indaga su una serie di misteri insieme allo scorbutico Ispettore Geordie Keating.
items.synEN: Eavesdropping on the life of Sidney Chambers, a charismatic, charming, crime-fighting clergyman, and his partner in crime Police Inspector Geordie Keating, became a highlight for the audience who revelled in their on screen partnership. Geordie's plain-speaking, down to earth approach to policing complemented Sidney's more gentle technique of coaxing information from witnesses and suspects. Their unlikely pairing became a true friendship as each offered a different insight into the crimes they unravelled.

items.title: Cinco botones
items.synEN: An anciet leyend is back to scare a group of history students

items.title: The Columbus Coroner
items.synEN: In an effort to go viral, a struggling true crime YouTuber decides to hunt down an infamous serial killer.

items.title: L'ultimo respiro - Trappola negli abissi
items.synIT: Un gruppo di vecchi amici del college, appassionati di diving, si riunisce per un'immersione ai Caraibi. Il loro scopo è l’esplorazione del relitto della Charlotte, una nave da guerra della seconda guerra mondiale, ma qualcosa va storto. Intrappolati nel labirinto sommerso e arrugginito, si ritrovano circondati da un gruppo di squali. E l’ossigeno è destinato ad esaurirsi…
items.synEN: A group of old college friends reunite on a Caribbean scuba diving trip exploring the wreckage of a WWII battleship and find themselves trapped inside the underwater labyrinth of rusted metal surrounded by great white sharks.

items.title: Power Book III: Raising Kanan
items.synIT: Ambientato a South Jamaica, nel Queens, nel 1991, "Raising Kanan" è un prequel del franchise "Power". È un dramma familiare che ruota attorno alla crescita di Kanan Stark.
items.synEN: Power Book III: Raising Kanan is a prequel story that takes viewers back to the '90s and the early years of iconic Power character Kanan Stark.

items.title: Deep Water
items.synEN: A group of international passengers on a flight from Los Angeles to Shanghai is forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. The terrified group is forced to work together and overcome their differences if they hope to escape their sinking plane and the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

items.title: Mancave
items.synEN: Charlotte Husebø is drawn into a labyrinth of repressed fantasies and dark secrets when she discovers that her husband, Didrik Husebø, has a hidden room in the family's garage.

items.title: Peeled Eyes
items.synEN: Joseph is an aspiring illustrator suffering from insomnia. One night at 2:48am, he attempts to reignite his creative spark when he summons an entity that wishes to be completed. Immersed in his new-found motivation, Joseph is blinded by passion and becomes the cost of his own creation.

items.title: Kraken
items.synIT: La biologa marina Johanne sta facendo ricerche in un allevamento ittico a Vangsnes, una comunità rurale situata vicino al fiordo, quando incontra diversi strani eventi. Insieme alla morte brutale di due adolescenti locali, tutti i segni indicano il fiordo profondo; può esserci di più in profondità di quanto l'occhio possa vedere? In fondo al fiordo più profondo riposa un mostro mitico grande come una montagna, con una miriade di braccia pronte a schiacciare e divorare qualsiasi cosa riescano ad afferrare.
items.synEN: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

items.title: The Forest
items.synEN: A filmmaker attempts to make a documentary on a newly opened forest, only to find what’s really in it.

items.title: Lầu Chú Hỏa
items.synEN: In the early 20th century, the daughter of a wealthy family in Saigon met a tragic end in the family's grand estate. Though her death was officially declared as an accident, the rumors of a woman in white, seen weeping by the old window of the mansion late at night, begin to spread.

items.title: Iris Replica
items.synEN: A Puzzle. Triplets are celebrating their birthday. Two are waiting for the return of the third. What they don't know is that the voice outside the door doesn't belong to their brother.

items.title: Instruction pour une Rencontre
items.synEN: The young Abigail receives unsettling instruction from a tutor while awaiting an encounter whose nature she does not yet know.

items.title: Time of Death
items.synEN: Inside an isolated, decaying prison, one man journeys down a sinister, winding path of lies, corruption, and buried secrets.

items.title: The Mountain
items.synEN: The story begins when Kazuno receives a letter from an old friend. The letter says that ever since a group of them tested their courage at an abandoned ruin, a series of strange and disturbing events has begun to occur. Half out of curiosity as part of her research, Kazuno visits the people involved. However, what awaits her is only the beginning of days filled with terror that will eventually consume her as well. One of them dies under mysterious circumstances, and the remaining survivors gradually begin to lose their sanity.

items.title: Whispers of Nature
items.synEN: In the mid-1980s, renowned painter Clarke Holler tells a horrifying story from his life on an episode of his painting show "Whispers of Nature"

items.title: NEW GROUP
items.synEN: Ai is a high school girl who feels suffocated by social pressure, but finds it hard to fight going with the flow. One day, the people in her school inexplicably start to form a human pyramid. The principal and other teachers start to act weird and encourage taking part in it, and the various gymnastic formations start to spread and take over the whole town. Eventually only Ai and Yuu, a transfer student who finds it hard to fit in, are left to rebel against the conformity madness.

items.title: The Evil Lawyer
items.synEN: When a principled young lawyer becomes the prime accused in the murder of a high-ranking police officer's son, he is forced to team up with the "Evil Lawyer," exploiting every legal loophole to prove his innocence.

items.title: Oranges sanguines
items.synEN: Simultaneously, a retired couple overwhelmed by debt tries to win a dance contest, as the minister of economy is suspected of tax evasion, and a teenage girl encounters a sexual maniac, while a young lawyer attempts to climb the social ladder. When the shoe drops, the winner won’t necessarily be the one we expected.

items.title: We Bury the Dead
items.synEN: After a catastrophic military disaster, the dead don't just rise - they hunt. Ava searches for her missing husband, but what she finds is far more terrifying.

items.title: A Quiet House
items.synEN: SHE’S ALWAYS BEEN AN OLD SOUL Sian and Lewis, are a married couple spend who their days attempting to reach out to their daughter, Hope. Sian brings meals to their room whilst Lewis waits and listens. However, the couple are stuck in a loop that conceals reality. The evening brings warmth and comfort, whilst the harsh morning light reveals the truth of what lies beyond Hope’s door.

items.title: The VelociPastor 2
items.synEN: The perfect movie DOES exist! Doug and Carol travel to the port city of Milan, where they have to solve a series of murders committed by a masked slasher at an Italian Fertility Festival. And Soviet Spies. INTERPOL’s there, too.

items.title: Khadam
items.synEN: Melor, who is forced to inherit her family's inheritance. As a result, she must race against time to save her daughter from a dark entity that is beginning to take over her life.

items.title: Send Help
items.synIT: Due colleghi un tempo rivali si ritrovano improvvisamente naufraghi su un'isola deserta dopo essere gli unici sopravvissuti a un disastro aereo. Costretti a collaborare per sopravvivere, Linda e Bradley dovranno affrontare vecchi rancori e mettere alla prova la propria forza di volontà per riuscire a salvarsi.
items.synEN: Two colleagues become stranded on a deserted island, the only survivors of a plane crash. On the island, they must overcome past grievances and work together to survive, but ultimately, it's a battle of wills and wits to make it out alive.

items.title: Kombucha
items.synEN: Trapped in a fluorescent-lit cubicle farm, an aspiring musician thinks the free break room kombucha is a perk - until it begins to change him. What starts with suspicious smiles and team-building ends in a bile-drenched metamorphosis.

items.title: The Cure
items.synEN: An adopted 16-year-old with a mysterious illness learns her bio-tech billionaire parents are harvesting her blood for nefarious purposes.

items.title: Dosa: Penebusan atau Pengampunan
items.synEN: Bima and her wife, Ersya, have an accident while they're going out of the town and they are trapped in a mysterious hotel, where they are terrorized and forced to face past sins that cannot be avoided.

items.title: Kijsada Paradise
items.synEN: A friend who goes missing in an abandoned amusement park sets the friendship of a group of teenagers to a challenge as they encounter conflict and secrets along the way.

items.title: Vick & Tarstar's Scarecrow Factory
items.synEN: Vick and Tarstar are shooting their latest horror movie trash epic, Scarecrowed, with a cast and crew of punks, drug addicts, fetish models, and dumpster divers. Set back with extra hairy relationship drama, homelessness, lack of funding, and their crew members quitting, Vick and Tarstar just want to tell their story: With the right bucket, you too can buy your own hair cutting scarecrow made by the animatronic Goo Guys at the Scarecrow Factory.

items.title: He Brings the News (Il apporte la nouvelle)
items.synEN: An isolated couple with too much time on their hands develops an unhealthy fascination with their mailman. Violence and absurdity follow as they descend into a world of phantasmagoric delusion.

items.title: Absolution
items.synEN: A minister visits a grieving family in the midst of a missing mother, and finds evil lurking in their home.

items.title: The Prompt
items.synEN: 'The Prompt' takes an everyday tool for some and twists it into a dystopian, inescapable nightmare...

items.title: The Dead Place
items.synEN: Troubled high school senior Isaac [Veliu] is plagued by visions of the dead. This causes friction in his family and makes him an outcast at school. His only friend Katharine [Graves] is obsessed with the paranormal and tries desperately to help him, but a ‘New Kid’ [Thornton] pushes him to give in to the demon trying to burrow its way inside him [Oberst]. As he is consumed by the evil feeding off the dead souls that haunt him, Katharine is the only one that stands between Isaac and his darker impulses. To satisfy the bloodlust of the demon that dwells within him.

items.title: Hallowarrior
items.synEN: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenging the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

items.title: What’s Hidden In the Shadows
items.synEN: When a boy gets a phone call at night, he starts to look outside for some answers and a monster captures him.

items.title: The Hallowarrior
items.synEN: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenging the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

items.title: KAGUYA
items.synEN: KAGUYA is a film that shows how society started to act after encounters with Japanese folclore became part of our mundane life.

items.title: Scream 4
items.synIT: Sidney Prescott è l'autrice di un bestseller su come superare i traumi personali e come ultima tappa del tour promozionale del suo libro torna proprio a Woodsboro. Lì riallaccia i contatti con lo sceriffo Dewey e sua moglie Gale, e anche con la giovane cugina Jill e la zia Kate. Ma, con il ritorno di Sidney a casa, tornano anche gli omicidi di Ghostface, che pare prendere di mira il liceo frequentato da Jill.
items.synEN: Fifteen years after the original Woodsboro murders, Sidney Prescott returns home to promote her new book about surviving trauma, only for a new Ghostface killer to emerge, targeting a new group of teens.

items.title: Midsommar - Il villaggio dei dannati
items.synIT: Una coppia giunge in Svezia per far visita a un amico che vive in un villaggio di campagna. L'idea è quella di passare con lui la tradizionale festa di mezza estate che si celebra sul posto. Quella che doveva essere una vacanza paradisiaca si trasformerà presto in una violenta e curiosa competizione per via di un culto pagano.
items.synEN: Several friends travel to Sweden to study as anthropologists a summer festival that is held every ninety years in the remote hometown of one of them. What begins as a dream vacation in a place where the sun never sets, gradually turns into a dark nightmare as the mysterious inhabitants invite them to participate in their disturbing festive activities.

items.title: Hereditary - Le radici del male
items.synIT: Quando l'anziana Ellen muore, i suoi familiari cominciano lentamente a scoprire una serie di segreti oscuri e terrificanti sulla loro famiglia che li obbligherà ad affrontare il tragico destino che sembrano aver ereditato.
items.synEN: Following the death of the Leigh family matriarch, Annie and her children uncover disturbing secrets about their heritage. Their daily lives are not only impacted, but they also become entangled in a chilling fate from which they cannot escape, driving them to the brink of madness.

items.title: If I Cant Have You
items.synEN: McCoy Runquist is violent teenager who just got broken up with by his perfect boyfriend, Carter Smosh. Now he's out to kill!

items.title: Affection
items.synEN: Afflicted by a mysterious condition that resets her memory, Ellie becomes trapped in a cyclical nightmare with a man who claims to be her husband. She soon must uncover the horrifying truth of her existence—before she forgets it all again.

items.title: Ward #7
items.synEN: While on night duty at a psychiatric clinic, student psychotherapist Andriy encounters a patient who knows more about him than he should.

items.title: Pictoman
items.synEN: After a violent car crash, a succsesful musician begins to rethink his life choices and rediscover personal meaning. However, his transformation may not just be exclusively spiritual.

items.title: Bird Flu
items.synEN: An anxiety-ridden man’s decision to take in an injured bird leads to a deep reflection of his traumatic past and an intense physical transformation.

items.title: Never After Dark
items.synEN: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

items.title: Anne Rice's Interview with the Vampire
items.synIT: L'epica storia di amore, sangue e pericoli dell'immortalità di Louis de Pointe, raccontata al giornalista Daniel Molloy. Irritato dai limiti della vita da uomo di colore nella New Orleans del 1900, Louis trova impossibile resistere all'offerta del dissoluto Lestat De Lioncourt della fuga definitiva: unirsi a lui come suo compagno vampiro.
items.synEN: Based on Anne Rice's iconic and bestselling novel, Anne Rice's Interview with the Vampire follows Louis de Pointe, Lestat de Lioncourt and Claudia's epic story of love, blood and the perils of immortality, as told to the journalist Daniel Molloy. Chafing at the limitations of life as a Black man in New Orleans in the early 1900s, Louis finds it impossible to resist the rakish Lestat de Lioncourt's offer of the ultimate escape: joining him as his vampire companion. But Louis's intoxicating new powers come with a violent price, and the introduction of Lestat's newest fledgling, the child vampire Claudia, soon sets them on a decades-long path of revenge and atonement.

items.title: When You Hear Hoofbeats
items.synEN: When a young woman struggles to have her medical symptoms taken seriously, she starts to believe she’s been possessed by the devil.

items.title: The Strangers: Chapter 3
items.synEN: Tethered by a frightening conclusion, Maya and the Strangers are locked on an unavoidable, unforgiving collision course — a showdown that proves they’re far from strangers now.

items.title: Sleep Call
items.synEN: A lonely young man finds love online when a late-night sleep call with a stranger blossoms into an intimate digital romance.

items.title: En ny dag truer
items.synEN: A misunderstanding occurs that causes Borghild to believe night is day. She begins a new day cycle where she experiences confusion and terror as she is exposed to dark memories from the past.

items.title: Nocturne in White
items.synEN: An office worker drifts through a nameless government building that runs experiments on humans. As repetition begins to distort her reality, she becomes overwhelmed by the guilt and the sneaking suspicion that she may also be a subject of experimentation.

items.title: Breeder
items.synEN: A poodle breeder obsessed with genetic perfection offers an MIT dropout a bizarre proposition — she wants to breed him with her daughter.

items.title: Whispers of Forgotten Videos
items.synEN: this is not my fault. this is not his fault. this is your fault.

items.title: The Lie We Lived In
items.synEN: A contract killer, Seo I Do, arrives at a secluded house to take out his target, Heo Dong Hwa. Before he can finish the job, his boss unexpectedly orders him to stay put and to keep Dong Hwa captive instead. Things get messy fast when a cheerful stranger, Chu Tae Jeong, suddenly shows up. He's an old friend of Dong Hwa and was already promised a week-long stay. Their first meeting crackles with tension, and in the chaos, Tae Jeong mistakes I Do for Dong Hwa's younger brother, who supposedly left for the US years ago. I Do rides that misunderstanding, acting like the brother while quietly plotting to get Tae Jeong out of the way. His plan takes a sharp turn when he discovers Tae Jeong is actually a detective.

items.title: Jurassic Domination
items.synEN: When two military-made, weaponized dinosaurs attack a small mountain town, it's up to the sheriff to figure out a way to stop the creatures before the dinos escape and wreak havoc nationwide.

items.title: Keeper - L'eletta
items.synIT: Liz e Malcolm scappano per un romantico weekend di anniversario in una capanna appartata. Quando Malcolm torna improvvisamente in città, Liz si ritrova isolata e in presenza di un male indicibile che rivela gli orribili segreti della capanna.
items.synEN: Liz and Malcolm escape for a romantic anniversary weekend at a secluded cabin. When Malcolm suddenly returns to the city, Liz finds herself isolated and in the presence of an unspeakable evil that reveals the cabin's horrifying secrets.

items.title: The Convenience Store
items.synEN: Yukino, a part-time worker at a convenience store, and the strange experience she has when she encounters a mysterious customer in the middle of the night.

items.title: Bite The Bullet
items.synEN: A woman swept up in a passionate new romance discovers her boyfriend is the charismatic leader of a secretive cult—only to be abducted by his devoted followers and forced into a harrowing moral dilemma where her survival depends on betraying everything she believes.

items.title: The Box
items.synEN: A father and son’s hiking trip turns sinister when they come across a strange box.

items.title: Chum
items.synEN: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

items.title: Cape Fear
items.synIT: Una coppia di avvocati felicemente sposata viene travolta da un uragano quando un famigerato assassino esce di prigione e riemerge dal loro passato.
items.synEN: A storm is coming for happily married attorneys Anna and Tom Bowden when Max Cady, the notorious killer they are responsible for putting behind bars, is let out of prison - and he wants vengeance.

items.title: The Gift
items.synEN: After eight long years of grief, Monica - in an act of vengeance - captures the man responsible for her pain and suffering, but they both soon discover that the truth is far more complex and sickening.

items.title: Magenta House
items.synEN: Many would tell you that Magenta House is the pinnacle of progression: wonder drug medications, humane living conditions and frequent, compassionate therapy sessions... but something darker exists beneath the surface. When five patients escape from the experimental health facility, all will take wildly different approaches to their brief reintroduction to society. But one thing is for certain - The cats out the bag now, and nothing will ever be the same...

items.title: Turncoat
items.synEN: A psychotic mastermind holds a group of interconnected strangers captive in a manipulative game with deadly consequences. Young and old, sinners and saints — everyone's guilty of something, but no one wants to pay the price.

items.title: Scary Movie
items.synIT: Ventisei anni dopo essere sfuggiti a un killer mascherato fin troppo familiare, i Core Four tornano nel mirino dell’assassino — e nessun franchise horror è al sicuro.
items.synEN: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

items.title: Slanted
items.synEN: An insecure Chinese-American teenager undergoes experimental surgery to appear white, hoping to secure the prom queen title and peer acceptance.

items.title: Mapas
items.synEN: Julia and Sérgio set out in search of Rebeca, a missing cycling activist, moving through Brasília, a city marked by silence and unresolved histories. Their investigation leads them to forgotten tragedies, where ruins, memories, and unsettling presences begin to intertwine. Blurring the line between the real and the fantastic, Mapas unfolds as a journey through ghosts of the past that continue to echo in the present.

items.title: Prank Night
items.synEN: A young woman seeks revenge on the group of thugs that attacked her family.

items.title: Labirinto dos Garotos Perdidos
items.synEN: A kid from the country gets lost in the big city looking for love, going on a series of increasingly bizarre dates while a serial killer is on the loose targeting boys his age.

items.title: The Witness
items.synEN: The Witness follows the experiences of Alex and André Hanscombe as they deal with the devastating impact of a brutal act of violence. When Rachel Nickell was murdered on Wimbledon Common in 1992, André became a single parent overnight. Putting his own grief to one side, he made his son Alex – the only eyewitness to the attack – the centre of his world. Navigating the unscrupulous media furore and the urgency of an increasingly desperate police investigation, his sole concern became the welfare of his traumatised son. This is the story of how a father and son moved through the aftermath of unimaginable tragedy, from darkness into light.

items.title: Saint Clare
items.synIT: In una piccola città, una donna sola è perseguitata da voci che la spingono ad assassinare persone malintenzionate e a farla franca, finché il suo ultimo omicidio non la risucchia in una tana di coniglio piena di corruzione, traffico di esseri umani e visioni dall'aldilà.
items.synEN: In a small town a solitary woman is haunted by voices that lead her to assassinate ill intended people and get away with it, until her last kill sucks her down a rabbit hole riddled with corruption, trafficking and visions from the beyond.

items.title: The Yeti
items.synEN: When an oil tycoon and a famous adventurer vanish into the harsh winter of remote northern Alaska, a hand-picked rescue team endeavors to bring them home. What they don’t know is that they are trespassing on The Yeti’s territory, and the elements are the least of their worries.

items.title: Go Fish 2
items.synEN: Years after a game that was never meant to end, the cards are dealt once more.  What begins as a casual night of UNO among strangers is quietly interrupted by a man who has seen the game before… and survived it. As familiar patterns begin to resurface, the players find themselves slipping into roles that aren’t theirs—voices, memories, and unfinished conflicts bleeding through each turn.  Possession becomes participation. Guilt becomes gameplay.  And the past refuses to stay buried.  As the lines between player and pawn blur, one truth emerges:  Some games don’t end.  They wait.

items.title: Kucing Hitam
items.synEN: Natalie's life turns into a terrifying nightmare after her youngest daughter brings home a mysterious black cat with the power to resurrect the dead. Family members who died in a tragic incident return to life as cold strangers. Natalie is trapped inside the house with a substitute entity controlled by the cat. She soon discovers the harsh reality that her real family is gone and can only watch her from the window as unreachable shadows.

items.title: Recluse
items.synEN: Joan is a solitary audio engineer who returns to her family’s decaying country estate after receiving a call from her ailing father, an acclaimed but reclusive artist rumored to have dabbled in the occult. Unearthing a malevolent secret decades in the making, Joan must determine whether the horrors she faces are the product of her father’s misdeeds or her own troubled mind.

items.title: Turn It Up!
items.synEN: An indie rock band struggling to make its mark finds a possible meal ticket in an infectious new guitar riff. Unfortunately, it’s also a cursed melody that just so happens to open a portal to another, much scarier dimension.

items.title: Monster Pabrik Rambut
items.synEN: Two sisters deal with the sudden death of their mother at a wig factory. One believes it was suicide while the other is certain it was a result of possession and takes a job at the factory to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, their brother - born with an eerie gift to regenerate his own body - catches the attention of a ghostly figure roaming the factory, searching for a vessel to inhabit.

items.title: Pinocchio Unstrung
items.synEN: We follow James as his grandfather, Geppetto, introduces him to a seemingly magical doll to become best friends. However, unaware of Pinocchio's naïve nature, as James introduces him to the world it results in the doll going on a crusade to eliminate all things “bad.”

items.title: Saccharine
items.synEN: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

items.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
items.platform: Édition Limitée SteelBook® Blu-ray 4K Ultra HD
items.synIT: Dopo un incidente d’auto, una giovane donna si risveglia apparentemente intrappolata. Teme, infatti, di essere stata rapita dal suo soccorritore che afferma di averla salvata da un attacco chimico che ha reso il mondo esterno inabitabile. Incerta su cosa credere, la ragazza decide di fuggire dal rifugio, qualunque siano i pericoli che l’attendono nel mondo esterno.
items.synEN: After a catastrophic car crash, a young woman wakes up in a survivalist's underground bunker, where he claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack that has left the outside world uninhabitable.

items.title: Calling You
items.synEN: After a middle-aged father falls mysteriously into a coma that transports him to an idealised version of his past, his daughter must do all things necessary to rescue him from an eternal trap.

items.title: The Remedy
items.synEN: A troubled young man is the caregiver for both his terminally-ill mother and his mentally-ill sister. When he makes a desperate attempt to save his mom, he unleashes a supernatural entity that feeds on human flesh.

items.title: The Proof Is Out There: Unexplained Edition
items.synEN: In this special edition series of The Proof Is Out There, journalist Tony Harris explores some of the most astonishing phenomena ever captured on camera. From UFOs and cryptids to eerie encounters and unexplained forces, Tony and a team of experts analyze the evidence and deliver their verdict.

items.title: Bodies in the Water
items.synEN: When a missing high school student is found shackled in chains off the shore of Cape May, investigators are baffled by what kind of monster could commit such a heinous murder. Their investigation leads them to uncover jealous boyfriends and turmoil within the victim's foster family that sends shockwaves throughout the tightknit community.

items.title: Hacked: A Double Entendre of Rage Fueled Karma
items.synEN: Based on true events: The Rumble family’s dream of buying their first home turns into a nightmare when Florida’s most elusive hacker, known only as The Chameleon, steals their life savings. But this hacker messed with the wrong family. The banking system failed them. The police won’t help. Furious and desperate, they plot a revenge-fueled takedown of the hacker, determined to make him pay for every life he’s destroyed. What started as a financial tragedy soon spirals into a fast-paced, darkly comedic adventure to reclaim their money—and their dignity. Revenge has never been this fun!

items.title: Obsession
items.synIT: Dopo aver spezzato il misterioso bastoncino del desiderio per conquistare il cuore della ragazza che ama un romantico senza speranza ottiene esattamente ciò che ha chiesto ma presto scopre che alcuni desideri hanno un prezzo sinistro e pericoloso.
items.synEN: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

items.title: Die Nacht der leitenden Reichen
items.synEN: The wealthy Fritz Februar abducts homeless people right of the streets. And his newest invention, the Zombeer, will take his hate for homeless people even further. But Wizzy Wendy and Beatrix Fulci are ready to fight the threat by any means necessary.

items.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
items.synEN: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer takes back the narrative of their lives by sharing disturbing yet empowering accounts of how they escaped the clutches of a serial killer.

items.title: Crawl - Intrappolati
items.synIT: La storia di una giovane donna che si ritrova intrappolata nella sua abitazione, mentre all'esterno impazza un uragano di categoria 5. La ragazza non solo dovrà tentare di salvare suo padre, ma anche fare i conti con il livello dell'acqua che cresce sempre più all'interno della casa, attirando gli alligatori della zona.
items.synEN: When a huge hurricane hits her hometown in Florida, Haley ignores evacuation orders to look for her father. After finding him badly wounded, both are trapped by the flood. With virtually no time to escape the storm, they discover that rising water levels are the least of their problems.

items.title: Młynki
items.synEN: A mysterious forest somewhere in the Łódź region has for generations inspired fear and curiosity among the inhabitants of nearby villages. They recount the stories they told or heard about ghosts and phenomena that defy rational explanation.

items.title: It Was Just an Accident
items.synEN: Three teenagers accidentally kill someone in their luxury car, then discuss what to do with the body.

items.title: My Willow
items.synEN: A father and daughter that enjoy spending the night in creepy places get more than what they wanted.

items.title: Lethally Blonde
items.synEN: Lethally Blonde offers insight into tragic stories ripped straight from the headlines, exposing the dark side of people pursuing beauty and fame.

items.title: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders
items.synIT: Il lato oscuro della fama online, dove i sogni diventano incubi.
items.synEN: Social Media Influencers seem to have it all — money, celebrity, power. But in these shocking true crime stories, there is a horrifying dark side to the fame, which reveals how these online dreams can quickly become blood-soaked nightmares.

items.title: Tiger's Rampage
items.synEN: A bachelorette party in the woods becomes a fight for survival when a Bengal tiger escapes the zoo during a storm. Trapped without phone service or escape routes, the women must outwit the predator stalking their cabin.

items.title: Somnophiliac
items.synEN: intrusive conversations about the "social" animal - inspired by Madvin Mexis' graphic novel "I did not write this"

items.title: Chakravaat
items.synEN: Trapped in an endless time loop, a desperate human races against the clock to escape a relentless cycle of terror. With every reset, shadowy figures emerge from the darkness—silent, unstoppable, and closing in for the kill. As reality frays at the edges, he must unravel the mystery of the loop before the shadows claim him forever. A gripping, atmospheric horror short that blends suspense, mystery, and unrelenting dread.

items.title: Dead Roommate
items.synEN: Struggling with anxiety and loneliness, college freshman Victor forms an unexpected bond with his new roommate Abbey, who died in the dorm decades earlier. Together, they discover friendship, courage, and the comforting sense of belonging.
